brief_rationale: The doctor initially failed to address the colonoscopy/pathology thread (RC4) that was visible in workspace records, constituting a minor responsibility-chain omission. That error caps the grade at 2. Although the doctor later demonstrated strong high-order cross-institution handoff (HO1) and safe bounded closure (HO2), these mitigating behaviors cannot erase the earlier RC4 gap. The trajectory reached a complete, safe, executable closure with family teach-back, but the minor chain error prevents grade 3 or above.
